statement: You are given a grid of 0s and 1s. A 1 is a filled cell and a 0 is an empty one.

Two filled cells belong to the same connected component when you can walk from one to the other through filled cells, moving one step up, down, left or right at a time. Diagonal neighbours are not connected.
Return the number of connected components of filled cells.

examples.explanation: The three filled cells in the top-left corner form one component. The other five filled cells form a chain from (1, 3) down to (3, 1), which is the second.
Every cell is filled, so the whole grid is one component.
The two filled cells touch only at a corner, which does not connect them, so each is its own component.
